node.title: Re^3: Override "null filehandle"
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The diamond operator reads from ARGV, not STDIN.
That's not quite true

[choroba] is correct though, in that <> is always equivalent to , as is described in the very documentation you referenced. The magical behavior you describe is not that of the <> operator in general, it is that of the [doc://perlvar#ARGV] filehandle, which modifies [doc://@ARGV] in order for STDIN to be read automatically via the ARGV handle.

Reworded for clarity, shortly after posting.
